question: What is the meaning of environmental cost indicators a1-d in relation to sustainability, environmental cost indicators?
description: Environmental cost indicators a1-d are used to assess the environmental impact of building materials. They are based on the normalized environmental performance (Ei) and the secondary life factor (w) to determine the final environmental score (E-score). The E-score ranges from 0 to 1, with 100% indicating the best environmental performance and 10% indicating the worst. These indicators help in evaluating the sustainability of building materials and their contribution to environmental degradation.
